title: Derived Leray composition
statement: Let f : Y ⟶ X and g : Z ⟶ Y be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let M be an arbitrary object of the unbounded derived category of abelian etale sheaves on Z [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Denote the derived direct images of the inverse-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] by R_f and R_g, their canonical mate composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] by D : R_g followed by R_f ≅ R_(g ≫ f), and the canonical Leray comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by lambda_h : R_h followed by RGamma_(target h) ≅ RGamma_(source h). Then RGamma_X(D_M) followed by lambda_(g ≫ f),M equals lambda_f,R_g(M) followed by lambda_g,M. There is no boundedness restriction on M.

proof.text: The underived direct-image and terminal-section comparisons associate. Both composites are evaluation on an iterated versus a composite base change of the terminal object. The comparison isomorphisms commute with the projections, so the pullback universal property identifies the two maps.

proof.text: The underived direct-image composition is the mate of inverse-image composition. Right deriving preserves this conjugacy under the adjunctions with exact left adjoint, so its right-derived composition agrees with the isomorphism D defined by conjugateIsoEquiv.

proof.text: Direct image preserves K-injective complexes because its left adjoint is exact. Hence the composite right-derived direct images followed by right-derived global sections satisfy the universal property with the composite unit. After precomposition with that unit, either side is the localization of the underived equality from step 1. The uniqueness clause of the right-derived universal property identifies the natural transformations. Evaluate at M.

theorem derivedLeray_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g f).hom.app M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (g ≫ f)).hom.app M =
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).hom.app
        ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).hom.app M
